verified_facts.text: The hotel is in Mendoza's city center, opposite the historic Plaza Independencia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Situated in the city center opposite the historic Plaza Independencia, the hotel includes a casino and spa.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an on-site casino, Casino Dreams Plaza, with slot machines, gaming tables and a VIP room.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our hotel's on-site casino offers excitement in the form of 550 state-of-the-art slot machines, plus gaming tables and a VIP room.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's Balcony of the Arts displays sculptures, paintings and other works from Mendoza, including work by Julio Le Parc.
